IT/OT convergence services

We connect operational technology on the plant floor with enterprise IT, so industrial data reaches the people and systems that need it.

ScrollAbu Dhabi — India

01OverviewCloud & Infrastructure

IT/OT Services

Operational technology (OT) runs physical processes: pumps, valves, production lines and building systems. Information technology (IT) runs the business. For years the two were kept apart, which left plant data out of reach of planners and analysts. IT/OT convergence connects them securely. Hamdaz provides IT/OT services for oil and gas, energy and other industrial operators in the UAE. We implement Industrial IoT (IIoT) to connect and optimise industrial processes, and integrate cyber-physical systems so digital and physical systems work together as one operation rather than as separate islands.

We deploy SCADA (supervisory control and data acquisition) systems for real-time monitoring and control, and modernise legacy operational technology that has become hard to maintain or secure. Edge computing processes data close to the equipment, so decisions can be made in real time even when links to the data centre are limited. Hamdaz is a registered ADNOC supplier, ICV certified and ISO 45001 certified for occupational health and safety, which matters on industrial sites. Our cybersecurity, data analytics and digital twin teams build on the same connections, turning OT data into monitoring, forecasts and maintenance plans.

05FAQs3 questions

IT/OT Services: common questions

More on Cloud & Infrastructure
Does connecting OT to IT increase cyber risk?

It can if done carelessly, which is why we design security in from the start. We segment networks, control which systems can talk to each other, monitor traffic and secure remote access. Our cybersecurity team works alongside the IT/OT engineers, so integration and protection are planned together rather than added afterwards.

Can you work with our existing SCADA and control systems?

Yes. Most projects start with equipment already in place. We assess your current SCADA, controllers and sensors, then decide whether to integrate, extend or modernise them. Legacy system modernisation upgrades older operational technology in stages, so production keeps running while improvements are made.

What is the role of edge computing in IT/OT?

Edge computing processes data at or near the industrial site instead of sending it all to a central system. It cuts delay for time-critical decisions, reduces the data sent over long links and keeps local monitoring working if a connection drops. Edge data can still feed central analytics, cloud platforms and digital twins.
